description_en: Queries the logical models under a specified gateway. Supports keyword filtering and token-based pagination with maxResults and nextToken
description_zh: 查询指定网关下的逻辑模型列表，支持按关键字筛选，使用 token 分页（maxResults + nextToken）
name: ListLogicalModels

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway instance. Specifies the gateway instance whose logical models you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 网关实例 ID，指定要查询逻辑模型的网关实例
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required. This operation uses token-based pagination with maxResults and nextToken, and does not use pageNumber or pageSize
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大条目数，取值 1–100，必填；本接口使用 token 分页（maxResults + nextToken），不使用 pageNumber/pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The nextToken value returned in the response of the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. The nextToken value is not returned for the last page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页响应返回的 nextToken；首页不传，最后一页不返回 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter logical models
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，用于筛选逻辑模型
parameters.name: keyword

availablePaths.description_en: The list of call paths commonly supported by all primary targets
availablePaths.description_zh: 所有主目标共同支持的调用路径列表
availablePaths.title_en: 全部主目标支持路径交集
availablePaths.title_zh: 全部主目标支持路径交集

callStrategy.description_en: The call strategy. This field is returned only for Auto. Valid values: balanced, cheap, fast, and quality. This field can be omitted. If omitted, the default strategy is balanced. This field is not returned for Mapping and Weighted
callStrategy.description_zh: 仅 Auto 返回的调用策略，取值 balanced、cheap、fast、quality；可省略，省略时基础策略为 balanced；Mapping/Weighted 不返回
callStrategy.title_en: 新版Auto返回balanced、cheap、fast或quality；旧配置可省略且基础名保持balanced；Mapping/Weighted省略
callStrategy.title_zh: 新版Auto返回balanced、cheap、fast或quality；旧配置可省略且基础名保持balanced；Mapping/Weighted省略

deployment.description_en: The configuration delivery record. A successful API response only indicates that the request is accepted, not that the configuration has taken effect
deployment.description_zh: 配置下发记录；接口返回成功仅表示已受理，不代表配置已生效

operationId.description_en: The ID of the current configuration delivery operation
operationId.description_zh: 本次配置下发操作 ID

status.description_en: The configuration delivery status. Valid values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, PartiallyFailed, and Failed. This status is independent of the API release status
status.description_zh: 配置下发状态，取值 Pending、Running、Succeeded、PartiallyFailed、Failed；该状态与 API 的发布状态无关

deployment.title_en: 保存意图对应独立配置下发；受理不表示生效
deployment.title_zh: 保存意图对应独立配置下发；受理不表示生效

fallbackTargets.description_en: The ordered fallback targets. A maximum of 5 fallback targets are supported. They are deduplicated by the actual card ID and can be an empty array
fallbackTargets.description_zh: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组

modelCardId.description_en: The ID of the actual source model card within the same instance

fallbackTargets.title_en: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组
fallbackTargets.title_zh: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组

features.description_en: The intersection of the Boolean capabilities of all primary targets
features.description_zh: 所有主目标布尔能力的交集

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the gateway instance to which the logical model belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 逻辑模型所属的网关实例 ID

logicalModelId.description_en: The logical model ID. The ID starts with vm-
logicalModelId.description_zh: 逻辑模型 ID，以 vm- 开头

meta.description_en: The aggregated information about the capabilities of the primary targets
meta.description_zh: 主目标能力的聚合信息

maxInputTokens.description_en: The minimum input token limit when all primary targets declare this limit. This field is not returned if any target's limit is unknown
maxInputTokens.description_zh: 所有主目标均声明时的最小输入 token 上限；任一目标未知时不返回
maxInputTokens.title_en: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略
maxInputTokens.title_zh: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略

maxOutputTokens.description_en: The minimum output token limit when all primary targets declare this limit. This field is not returned if any target's limit is unknown
maxOutputTokens.description_zh: 所有主目标均声明时的最小输出 token 上限；任一目标未知时不返回
maxOutputTokens.title_en: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略
maxOutputTokens.title_zh: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略

maxTokens.description_en: The minimum total token limit when all primary targets declare this limit. This field is not returned if any target's limit is unknown
maxTokens.description_zh: 所有主目标均声明时的最小总 token 上限；任一目标未知时不返回
maxTokens.title_en: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略
maxTokens.title_zh: 全部主目标已知时取最小值，否则省略

supportedInputModalities.description_en: The input modalities commonly supported by all primary targets
supportedInputModalities.description_zh: 所有主目标共同支持的输入模态

supportedOutputModalities.description_en: The output modalities commonly supported by all primary targets
supportedOutputModalities.description_zh: 所有主目标共同支持的输出模态

name.description_en: The client logical call name. It supports up to 256 bytes in UTF-8, must not contain spaces or slashes, and must not start with auto
name.description_zh: 客户端逻辑调用名，UTF-8最多256字节，不含空白或斜杠，不以auto开头
name.title_en: 客户端逻辑调用名，UTF-8最多256字节，不含空白或斜杠，不以auto开头
name.title_zh: 客户端逻辑调用名，UTF-8最多256字节，不含空白或斜杠，不以auto开头

requiresActivation.description_en: Specifies whether activation is required. This field is returned only for Auto. If the AI Credits Router commodity is not activated, the value is true. If it is activated, the value is false. This field is omitted if the read operation fails or the status is unknown. This field is omitted for Mapping and Weighted
requiresActivation.description_zh: 仅Auto返回：AI Credits Router商品未开通为true，已开通为false；读取失败或未知时省略；Mapping/Weighted省略
requiresActivation.title_en: 仅Auto返回：AI Credits Router商品未开通为true，已开通为false；读取失败或未知时省略；Mapping/Weighted省略
requiresActivation.title_zh: 仅Auto返回：AI Credits Router商品未开通为true，已开通为false；读取失败或未知时省略；Mapping/Weighted省略

responseModel.description_en: The response model type. If Actual is specified, the public name of the actual model is returned. If Logical is specified, the entry name of the logical model is returned
responseModel.description_zh: 响应模型类型：Actual 返回实际模型的公开名称，Logical 返回逻辑模型入口名称
responseModel.title_en: Actual返回实际模型公开名，Logical返回入口名，含SSE
responseModel.title_zh: Actual返回实际模型公开名，Logical返回入口名，含SSE

revision.description_en: The object version number. The initial value is 1 upon creation and increments with each successful update
revision.description_zh: 对象版本号，创建时为 1，每次成功更新递增

routingPolicy.description_en: The routing policy. Valid values: Mapping, Weighted, and Auto. If Auto is specified, targets must be an empty array and slots is required

slots.description_en: The slots. This field is returned only for Auto. Each of the simple, standard, and complex slots contains 1 to 3 source cards. The three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId. This field is omitted for Mapping and Weighted
slots.description_zh: 仅Auto返回；simple/standard/complex各1至3张源卡，三槽按modelCardId全局去重；Mapping/Weighted省略

complex.description_en: The complex slot, which contains 1 to 3 source cards. The three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId
complex.description_zh: complex槽1至3张源卡；三槽按modelCardId全局去重

modelCardId.description_en: The ID of the actual source model card within the same instance. The ID starts with msc-. VM or service overrides are not supported
modelCardId.description_zh: 同实例实际源卡ID，msc-；不支持VM或服务覆盖

targets.description_en: The primary targets. For Mapping, exactly one target is allowed. For Weighted, the sum of original relative weights must be greater than 0. For Auto, this must be an empty array
targets.description_zh: 主目标；Mapping恰好一项，Weighted原始相对权重总值大于0，Auto必须为空数组

weight.description_en: The weight. It is an integer from 0 to 10000 and is saved as the original value. A value of 0 is allowed for Mapping

targets.title_zh: 主目标；Mapping恰好一项，Weighted原始相对权重总值大于0，Auto必须为空数组
